title: Kissed Roasted Brazilian Beef Skewers
description: A light and quick-fix Brazilian dish featuring lean minced beef, coconut cream, and a touch of spice, all FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the minced beef, coconut cream, lime juice, olive oil, garlic-infused oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Mix everything together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Thread the beef mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
